description: On-chain firewall for an AI agent spending from a SOL vault on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.32.1, MagicBlock ephemeral-rollup ready). initialize, deposit, execute_hook (with a CPI into the allowed mock_swap program) and update_policy were verified; over-limit spends, wrong targets, wrong agents, vault-as-recipient and stranger policy updates were blocked.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of Timadigwe/agent_firewall. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agent_firewall. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (execute_hook policy checks and CPI)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/agent-firewall/
QA: devnet proof of blocked and allowed agent spends
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Add a daily cap and owner withdraw to Agent Firewall
